reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and, consistent with that, the proposal contains no redline and no counterparty comment — the rendered text is identical to the originals, which is the expected output for a compliance finding.

The cited paragraphs support the conclusion: p0084 obliges payment only of the fees set out in the Fee Schedule with no minimum, take-or-pay or shortfall construct; p0065 runs maintenance on a renewable one-year term rather than a locked multi-year commitment; and p0118 gives Sparkling (Customer) an unconditional 90-day termination right, providing the exit the rule requires.

No deterministic checks fired and there is no directional error — the analysis correctly distinguishes license-scope/use restrictions (Authorized Locations, copy limits) from purchase-volume commitments, matching the rule's detection guidance.

Minor, non-disqualifying: the rationale cites p0028 and Section 3 which are not among the supplied paragraphs, so those specific assertions are unverified; the compliance conclusion nonetheless rests adequately on the paragraphs provided.
